test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option for the given group of words.**

Substance used for killing troublesome small animals like insects, mice, etc.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pesticide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given options:__
 
• Pesticide: A chemical used to kill pests 
 
• Infanticide: Murdering an infant.
 
• Homicide: Killing of a human being.
 
• Fungicide: Killing of fungi.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 __some one-word substitutions with the root word- CIDE (Killing).__

 
• Killing/ Murder of a king - Regicide
 
• The killing of an Infant/ newborn baby - Infanticide
 
• The killing of a race or community - Genocide
 
• The killing of One's sister - **Sororicide**
 
• The killing of self or self-murder - Suicide
 
• The killing of one's mother - Matricide
 
• The killing of One's Father - **Patricide.**
 
• The killing of one's husband - Mariticide
 
• The killing of one's wife - Uxoricide
